# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by packages/gateway/scripts/config-docs.ts from the zod schema. Do not edit by
     hand: run `pnpm --filter switchyard-gateway schema` (CI fails when this file is stale). -->

Switchyard reads one YAML file. The CLI looks for `--config <file>`, then `$SWITCHYARD_CONFIG`,
then `./gateway.yaml`. `switchyard init` writes a starter file, and
[config/gateway.example.yaml](../config/gateway.example.yaml) is a fully commented example.

- **Environment interpolation:** every string value supports `${VAR}` (an error if unset),
  `${VAR:-default}` (the default if unset or empty) and `${VAR-default}` (the default only if
  unset). Write `$${` for a literal `${`. Interpolation runs on parsed values, never on raw
  text, and before validation, so numbers and booleans can come from the environment too. A
  `./.env` file (or `--env-file`) is loaded first; real environment variables win.
- **Validation:** `switchyard validate-config [file]` reports errors with their paths, for
  example `routes.chat.targets[1]: unknown model "missing"`. Unknown keys are ignored at
  runtime, but the JSON Schema flags them in editors.
- **Editor support:** add this first line to get completion, hover docs and typo detection in
  any editor with the YAML language server (VS Code, JetBrains, Neovim, …):

  ```yaml
  # yaml-language-server: $schema=https://unpkg.com/switchyard-gateway/config.schema.json
  ```

  The schema also ships in the package as `switchyard-gateway/config.schema.json`.

- **Reload:** `SIGHUP` or `POST /admin/config/reload` swaps providers, models and routes
  atomically. Connection settings (`server`, `redis`, `database`) need a restart.

Durations are in milliseconds (`*_ms`) or seconds (`*_s`), and money is in USD.

## Top-level keys

| Key             | Type                      | Default      | Description                                                                 |
| --------------- | ------------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `server`        | object                    |              | HTTP server.                                                                |
| `auth`          | object                    |              | Client authentication.                                                      |
| `providers`     | map of object (by `type`) | **required** | Upstream connections, by name. Discriminated by `type`.                     |
| `models`        | map of object             | **required** | Concrete upstream models ("targets"), by name.                              |
| `routes`        | map of object             | **required** | Virtual models exposed to clients: the `model` field of every request.      |
| `retry`         | object                    |              | Retry defaults (routes may override).                                       |
| `breaker`       | object                    |              | Circuit breaker defaults (per target).                                      |
| `pricing_file`  | string                    |              | Path to the pricing table (relative to the config file).                    |
| `redis`         | object                    |              | Redis (optional; without it everything is in-memory, per process).          |
| `database`      | object                    |              | Postgres (optional; required for database keys, budgets and usage reports). |
| `limits`        | object                    |              | Rate limits (need Redis).                                                   |
| `budgets`       | object                    |              | Team budgets (need Redis + Postgres).                                       |
| `usage`         | object                    |              | Usage pipeline (Redis stream → worker → Postgres).                          |
| `metrics`       | object                    |              | Prometheus metrics (see docs/METRICS.md).                                   |
| `observability` | object                    |              | Logging.                                                                    |

## Server: `server`

HTTP server.

| Key                         | Type                   | Default     | Description                                             |
| --------------------------- | ---------------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `server.port`               | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 65535) | `8787`      | Listen port (`PORT` env / `--port` override it).        |
| `server.host`               | string                 | `"0.0.0.0"` | Bind address.                                           |
| `server.request_timeout_ms` | integer (≥ 1)          | `300000`    | Hard cap for one request, streams included.             |
| `server.body_limit_mb`      | number (> 0)           | `10`        | Max request body size.                                  |
| `server.shutdown_grace_ms`  | integer (≥ 1)          | `15000`     | How long SIGTERM waits for in-flight requests to drain. |

## Authentication: `auth`

Client authentication.

| Key                                      | Type          | Default    | Description                                                                                    |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `auth.admin_token`                       | string        |            | Bearer token of the admin API (`SWITCHYARD_ADMIN_TOKEN`); admin API is off when unset.         |
| `auth.static_keys`                       | object[]      |            | Keys defined in config (bootstrap/dev/CI); database keys are the normal path.                  |
| `auth.static_keys[].key`                 | string        |            | The key, ≥ 12 characters (use `${ENV}`); entries with an empty key are skipped with a warning. |
| `auth.static_keys[].team`                | string        |            | Team slug the key belongs to.                                                                  |
| `auth.static_keys[].name`                | string        | `"static"` | Label used in logs and usage reports.                                                          |
| `auth.static_keys[].allowed_routes`      | string[]      |            | Route names this key may call; omitted = all routes.                                           |
| `auth.static_keys[].allow_direct_models` | boolean       | `false`    | Allow calling `models:` entries directly by name (not only routes).                            |
| `auth.static_keys[].rpm`                 | integer (> 0) |            | Requests per minute for this key.                                                              |
| `auth.static_keys[].tpm`                 | integer (> 0) |            | Tokens per minute for this key.                                                                |
| `auth.key_cache_ttl_s`                   | integer (> 0) | `60`       | TTL of the Redis key-record cache (DB keys). Revocation is pushed via pub/sub.                 |
| `auth.local_key_cache_ttl_ms`            | integer (≥ 0) | `5000`     | TTL of the per-process key cache in front of Redis.                                            |

## Providers: `providers`

Upstream connections, by name. Discriminated by `type`.

A map from your provider name to its settings. `type` selects the adapter:

- `opencode`: Bridge to an `opencode serve` instance (e.g. GitHub Copilot models).
- `openai-compatible`: Any OpenAI-compatible server: llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, Groq, OpenRouter, …
- `openai`: OpenAI API (native passthrough).
- `anthropic`: Anthropic Messages API (translated from/to OpenAI shape).
- `mock`: Deterministic in-process mock (tests, demos, benchmarks).
- `custom`: Your own adapter, registered via `createGateway({ adapterFactories })`.

### `type: opencode`

| Key                                   | Type                        | Default                   | Description                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `providers.<name>.enabled`            | boolean                     | `true`                    | Set false to disable the provider (and its models).                                     |
| `providers.<name>.max_concurrency`    | integer (≥ 0)               | `0`                       | Maximum concurrent upstream requests for this provider (0 = unlimited).                 |
| `providers.<name>.queue_timeout_ms`   | integer (≥ 1)               | `30000`                   | How long a request may wait for a concurrency slot before failing with `upstream_busy`. |
| `providers.<name>.timeout_ms`         | integer (≥ 1)               | `120000`                  | Per-attempt upstream timeout.                                                           |
| `providers.<name>.headers`            | map of string               |                           | Extra headers sent upstream.                                                            |
| `providers.<name>.base_url`           | string (uri)                | `"http://127.0.0.1:4096"` | opencode server URL.                                                                    |
| `providers.<name>.username`           | string                      | `"opencode"`              | Basic-auth user of the opencode server.                                                 |
| `providers.<name>.password`           | string                      |                           | Basic-auth password (`OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD`).                                       |
| `providers.<name>.agent`              | string                      | `"gateway"`               | opencode agent used for every session (should have all built-in tools disabled).        |
| `providers.<name>.upstream_provider`  | string                      | `"github-copilot"`        | opencode providerID for upstream models.                                                |
| `providers.<name>.session_title`      | string                      | `"switchyard"`            | Title prefix of the (always deleted) per-request sessions.                              |
| `providers.<name>.streaming`          | `"events"` \| `"synthetic"` | `"events"`                | `events`: true streaming via opencode's /event SSE; `synthetic`: await then chunk.      |
| `providers.<name>.repair_attempts`    | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 3)          | `1`                       | Max repair round-trips for emulated tool calls / JSON mode.                             |
| `providers.<name>.temperature_models` | string[]                    | `[]`                      | Models that accept temperature/top_p (others have these params dropped).                |

## Models: `models`

Concrete upstream models ("targets"), by name.

A map from the model name to its settings.

| Key                                      | Type                                    | Default  | Description                                                                                      |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `models.<name>.provider`                 | string                                  |          | Name of an entry in `providers`.                                                                 |
| `models.<name>.model`                    | string                                  |          | Upstream model id.                                                                               |
| `models.<name>.kind`                     | `"chat"` \| `"embedding"` \| `"rerank"` | `"chat"` | What the model serves; routes may only mix models of one kind.                                   |
| `models.<name>.base_url`                 | string (uri)                            |          | Per-model base URL override (llama.cpp serves one model per port).                               |
| `models.<name>.input_templates`          | object                                  |          | Embedding templates selected by the request's `input_type`; `{text}` and `{title}` are replaced. |
| `models.<name>.input_templates.query`    | string                                  |          | Template for `input_type: query`.                                                                |
| `models.<name>.input_templates.document` | string                                  |          | Template for `input_type: document`.                                                             |
| `models.<name>.pricing`                  | object                                  |          | Model pricing (USD per 1M tokens). Overrides the pricing_file entry.                             |
| `models.<name>.pricing.input`            | number (≥ 0)                            | `0`      | USD per 1M input tokens.                                                                         |
| `models.<name>.pricing.output`           | number (≥ 0)                            | `0`      | USD per 1M output tokens (reasoning tokens are billed as output).                                |
| `models.<name>.pricing.cached_input`     | number (≥ 0)                            |          | USD per 1M cached input tokens (defaults to `input`).                                            |
| `models.<name>.pricing.cache_write`      | number (≥ 0)                            |          | USD per 1M cache-write tokens (defaults to `input`).                                             |
| `models.<name>.pricing.per_request`      | number (≥ 0)                            |          | Flat USD fee per request (e.g. rerank searches).                                                 |
| `models.<name>.timeout_ms`               | integer (≥ 1)                           |          | Per-attempt timeout override.                                                                    |
| `models.<name>.context_window`           | integer (> 0)                           |          | Context window, used for pre-flight estimates only.                                              |
| `models.<name>.params`                   | map of any                              |          | Request body defaults merged under the client request (OpenAI-family upstreams).                 |
| `models.<name>.options`                  | map of any                              |          | Provider specific options (e.g. mock faults).                                                    |
| `models.<name>.description`              | string                                  |          | Free text (shown nowhere; for humans).                                                           |

## Routes: `routes`

Virtual models exposed to clients: the `model` field of every request.

A map from the route name to its settings.

| Key                                           | Type                                                                                         | Default      | Description                                                                       |
| --------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `routes.<name>.description`                   | string                                                                                       |              | Shown in `GET /v1/models`.                                                        |
| `routes.<name>.targets`                       | (string \| object)[]                                                                         |              | Models this route dispatches to (in fallback order for `fallback`).               |
| `routes.<name>.targets[].model`               | string                                                                                       |              | Model name (entry in `models`).                                                   |
| `routes.<name>.targets[].weight`              | number (> 0)                                                                                 | `1`          | Share for `strategy: weighted`.                                                   |
| `routes.<name>.targets[].timeout_ms`          | integer (≥ 1)                                                                                |              | Per-attempt timeout for this target.                                              |
| `routes.<name>.strategy`                      | `"fallback"` \| `"weighted"` \| `"least-latency"`                                            | `"fallback"` | How targets are ordered per request.                                              |
| `routes.<name>.retry`                         | object                                                                                       |              | Overrides the top-level `retry` for this route.                                   |
| `routes.<name>.retry.attempts`                | integer (> 0, ≤ 10)                                                                          | `2`          | Total attempts per target (1 = no retry).                                         |
| `routes.<name>.retry.backoff_ms`              | integer (≥ 0)                                                                                | `250`        | Base delay of exponential backoff with full jitter.                               |
| `routes.<name>.retry.max_backoff_ms`          | integer (≥ 0)                                                                                | `4000`       | Cap of the backoff delay.                                                         |
| `routes.<name>.retry.max_retry_after_ms`      | integer (≥ 0)                                                                                | `20000`      | Upper bound for honoring upstream Retry-After.                                    |
| `routes.<name>.timeout_ms`                    | integer (≥ 1)                                                                                |              | Total deadline for the whole request across retries and fallbacks.                |
| `routes.<name>.cache`                         | object                                                                                       |              | Response caching (off unless configured).                                         |
| `routes.<name>.cache.exact`                   | object                                                                                       |              | Exact-match cache for deterministic requests (temperature unset/0, n ≤ 1).        |
| `routes.<name>.cache.exact.ttl_s`             | integer (> 0)                                                                                |              | Entry lifetime in seconds.                                                        |
| `routes.<name>.cache.exact.enabled`           | boolean                                                                                      | `true`       | Set false to disable without removing the TTL.                                    |
| `routes.<name>.cache.semantic`                | object                                                                                       |              | Semantic cache on Redis 8 vector sets (needs Redis; requests without tools only). |
| `routes.<name>.cache.semantic.enabled`        | boolean                                                                                      | `false`      | Turn the semantic cache on for this route.                                        |
| `routes.<name>.cache.semantic.embed_route`    | string                                                                                       |              | Embedding route used to embed the prompt.                                         |
| `routes.<name>.cache.semantic.min_similarity` | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1)                                                                            | `0.95`       | Cosine similarity needed for a semantic hit.                                      |
| `routes.<name>.cache.semantic.ttl_s`          | integer (> 0)                                                                                |              | Entry lifetime (default: the exact TTL).                                          |
| `routes.<name>.cache.shared`                  | boolean                                                                                      | `false`      | Share entries across teams (default: namespaced per team).                        |
| `routes.<name>.defaults`                      | object                                                                                       |              | Request parameters applied when the client does not set them.                     |
| `routes.<name>.defaults.reasoning_effort`     | `"minimal"` \| `"low"` \| `"medium"` \| `"high"` \| `"xhigh"` \| `"max"` \| `"none"` \| null |              | Default `reasoning_effort` (null = none).                                         |
| `routes.<name>.defaults.max_tokens`           | integer (> 0)                                                                                |              | Default `max_tokens`; also bounds the pre-flight cost estimate.                   |
| `routes.<name>.defaults.temperature`          | number (≥ 0, ≤ 2)                                                                            |              | Default `temperature`.                                                            |
| `routes.<name>.hidden`                        | boolean                                                                                      | `false`      | Hide from GET /v1/models (still callable).                                        |

## Retries: `retry`

Retry defaults (routes may override).

| Key                        | Type                | Default | Description                                         |
| -------------------------- | ------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `retry.attempts`           | integer (> 0, ≤ 10) | `2`     | Total attempts per target (1 = no retry).           |
| `retry.backoff_ms`         | integer (≥ 0)       | `250`   | Base delay of exponential backoff with full jitter. |
| `retry.max_backoff_ms`     | integer (≥ 0)       | `4000`  | Cap of the backoff delay.                           |
| `retry.max_retry_after_ms` | integer (≥ 0)       | `20000` | Upper bound for honoring upstream Retry-After.      |

## Circuit breakers: `breaker`

Circuit breaker defaults (per target).

| Key                            | Type              | Default | Description                                                                  |
| ------------------------------ | ----------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `breaker.enabled`              | boolean           | `true`  | Enable per-target circuit breakers.                                          |
| `breaker.window_s`             | integer (> 0)     | `30`    | Rolling window for the failure rate.                                         |
| `breaker.min_requests`         | integer (> 0)     | `10`    | Minimum requests in the window before the failure rate can trip the breaker. |
| `breaker.failure_rate`         | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1) | `0.5`   | Failure rate (0..1) that opens the breaker.                                  |
| `breaker.consecutive_failures` | integer (> 0)     | `5`     | Consecutive failures that open the breaker regardless of the rate.           |
| `breaker.cooldown_s`           | number (> 0)      | `30`    | First open period; doubles on every re-trip.                                 |
| `breaker.max_cooldown_s`       | number (> 0)      | `300`   | Cap of the open period.                                                      |

## Pricing: `pricing_file`

| Key            | Type   | Default | Description                                              |
| -------------- | ------ | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `pricing_file` | string |         | Path to the pricing table (relative to the config file). |

## Redis: `redis`

Redis (optional; without it everything is in-memory, per process).

| Key                        | Type          | Default | Description                                                                           |
| -------------------------- | ------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `redis.url`                | string        |         | Redis 8 URL. Enables shared limits, budgets, caches, breakers and the usage stream.   |
| `redis.key_prefix`         | string        | `"sy:"` | Prefix of every Redis key.                                                            |
| `redis.fail_open`          | boolean       | `true`  | Admit requests when Redis is unreachable (rate limits / budgets are skipped, logged). |
| `redis.connect_timeout_ms` | integer (≥ 1) | `5000`  | Connect timeout of the Redis clients.                                                 |

## Postgres: `database`

Postgres (optional; required for database keys, budgets and usage reports).

| Key                 | Type                 | Default | Description                                                                            |
| ------------------- | -------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `database.url`      | string               |         | Postgres URL. Enables database keys/teams/budgets, the usage ledger and the admin API. |
| `database.pool_max` | integer (> 0, ≤ 100) | `10`    | Connection pool size.                                                                  |

## Rate limits: `limits`

Rate limits (need Redis).

| Key                        | Type          | Default | Description                                                         |
| -------------------------- | ------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `limits.defaults`          | object        |         | Limits for keys and teams that set none themselves.                 |
| `limits.defaults.key`      | object        |         | Default per-key limits (key records override).                      |
| `limits.defaults.key.rpm`  | integer (> 0) |         | Requests per minute.                                                |
| `limits.defaults.key.tpm`  | integer (> 0) |         | Tokens per minute (prompt estimate + output).                       |
| `limits.defaults.team`     | object        |         | Default per-team limits (team records override).                    |
| `limits.defaults.team.rpm` | integer (> 0) |         | Requests per minute.                                                |
| `limits.defaults.team.tpm` | integer (> 0) |         | Tokens per minute (prompt estimate + output).                       |
| `limits.window_s`          | integer (> 0) | `60`    | Sliding-window length; RPM/TPM are defined per window (keep at 60). |

## Budgets: `budgets`

Team budgets (need Redis + Postgres).

| Key                            | Type                            | Default  | Description                                                                 |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `budgets.enforcement`          | `"hard"` \| `"soft"` \| `"off"` | `"hard"` | `hard` blocks with 402, `soft` only alerts, `off` disables budgets.         |
| `budgets.soft_threshold`       | number (≥ 0, ≤ 1)               | `0.8`    | Utilization that fires the soft alert (budgets may override).               |
| `budgets.alert_webhook`        | string \| null                  |          | URL that receives budget alerts as JSON (one attempt, deduplicated).        |
| `budgets.reconcile_interval_s` | integer (> 0)                   | `300`    | How often the worker reconciles Redis spend counters from Postgres rollups. |
| `budgets.definitions_ttl_ms`   | integer (≥ 0)                   | `30000`  | TTL of the per-process cache of team budget definitions.                    |

## Usage pipeline: `usage`

Usage pipeline (Redis stream → worker → Postgres).

| Key                       | Type                | Default      | Description                                                                             |
| ------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `usage.stream`            | string              | `"sy:usage"` | Redis stream that carries usage events.                                                 |
| `usage.batch_size`        | integer (> 0)       | `500`        | Max events per worker insert.                                                           |
| `usage.flush_interval_ms` | integer (≥ 1)       | `1000`       | Worker poll / flush interval.                                                           |
| `usage.retention_days`    | integer (> 0)       | `400`        | Monthly usage partitions older than this are dropped.                                   |
| `usage.in_process_writer` | boolean             | `false`      | Run the usage worker inside the gateway process (single-node setups).                   |
| `usage.stream_maxlen`     | integer (> 0)       | `1000000`    | Approximate MAXLEN for XADD.                                                            |
| `usage.buffer_max`        | integer (> 0)       | `10000`      | Events kept in memory while Redis is unavailable; older events are dropped beyond this. |
| `usage.consumer_group`    | string              | `"writers"`  | Redis consumer group of the workers.                                                    |
| `usage.claim_idle_ms`     | integer (≥ 1)       | `60000`      | Pending entries idle longer than this are reclaimed (XAUTOCLAIM) from dead consumers.   |
| `usage.partitions_ahead`  | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 24) | `2`          | Monthly partitions created ahead of time.                                               |

## Metrics: `metrics`

Prometheus metrics (see docs/METRICS.md).

| Key                       | Type                   | Default      | Description                                                            |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `metrics.enabled`         | boolean                | `true`       | Expose Prometheus metrics.                                             |
| `metrics.port`            | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 65535) |              | Serve /metrics on a separate port (e.g. 9464) instead of the API port. |
| `metrics.path`            | string                 | `"/metrics"` | Metrics endpoint path.                                                 |
| `metrics.default_metrics` | boolean                | `true`       | Include prom-client's Node.js process metrics.                         |

## Logging and observability: `observability`

Logging.

| Key                           | Type                                                                                   | Default  | Description                                                                  |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `observability.log_level`     | `"fatal"` \| `"error"` \| `"warn"` \| `"info"` \| `"debug"` \| `"trace"` \| `"silent"` | `"info"` | pino log level.                                                              |
| `observability.log_bodies`    | boolean                                                                                | `false`  | Reserved: prompt/response body logging is not implemented yet.               |
| `observability.metrics`       | boolean                                                                                | `true`   | Legacy switch; metrics are on only when this and `metrics.enabled` are true. |
| `observability.otel`          | object                                                                                 |          | Reserved: OpenTelemetry tracing is not implemented yet.                      |
| `observability.otel.enabled`  | boolean                                                                                | `false`  | Reserved.                                                                    |
| `observability.otel.endpoint` | string \| null                                                                         |          | Reserved.                                                                    |
